item.title: Details on Colin Gray's 15-year sentence for son's Appalache High School shooting
item.description: Colin Gray, father of Appalache High School shooter Colt Gray, was sentenced to 15 years in prison on Thursday for his role in the 2024 tragedy.

item.title: Mortgage rates hit highest level in a year amid inflation fears
item.description: Mortgage rates are drifting higher as the Fed's interest rate decision and war in the Middle East fuel inflation concerns.

item.title: George, Amal Clooney send note to mayor while evacuating home in France amid fires
item.description: The couple have evacuated their home in southeastern France due to wildfires burning through the region.

item.title: Most Americans believe war with Iran is not worth fighting, AP poll says
item.description: A poll from the Associated Press shows that two-thirds of Americans believe the Iran war is not worth fighting. CBS News chief White House correspondent reports.
